titleFormatted.en: [[monitor]] finishes a cycle at least [[multiplier]]x its usual duration

hint.en: Compares the cycle that just finished to the median of this monitor's own history — needs a handful of completed cycles first to have a meaningful median. Simpler and more predictable than statistical anomaly detection (μ±2σ), which struggles with the same skewed, multi-modal duration distributions real appliances produce.
